document.description: A valid Schengen visa can unlock visa-free entry or simplified entry procedures in certain non-Schengen destinations, subject to each destination's conditions

unlocks.conditions: Valid multiple-entry Schengen visa that has previously been used in a Schengen state
unlocks.notes: Visa exemption applies to foreign citizens who would otherwise require an Albanian visa.
Stay may not extend beyond the Schengen visa's expiry when its remaining validity is less than 30 days.
Visa-free entry, transit and stay is permitted for up to 90 days during a six-month period and within the visa's validity.

unlocks.conditions: Multiple-entry Schengen type C visa valid for at least five days beyond the intended stay
unlocks.notes: Maximum 15 days per entry, with total stay limited to 90 days in any 180-day period.
For nationals normally subject to the Bosnia and Herzegovina visa regime. One continuous stay may not exceed 30 days, with total stay capped at 90 days in any 180-day period and within visa validity.

unlocks.conditions: Valid visa, other than a transit visa, issued by an EU member state or a Schengen Agreement state
unlocks.notes: The exemption applies to nationals identified by Moldova's visa-regime list and lasts within the supporting visa's validity.
Mexican visa exemption applies for tourism, business, transit or study without remuneration from a Mexican source, subject to immigration authorization at entry.
Belize lists a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa as an exemption from the Belize entry-visa requirement for visits not exceeding 30 days.
Citizens who normally require a Kosovo visa are exempt for entry, transit or stay for up to 15 days when holding a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa.

unlocks.conditions: Valid visa or residence issued by a qualifying country, including an EU member state; a Schengen visa issued by an EU member state can satisfy this route
unlocks.notes: Current Panama guidance cites Executive Decrees 521 and 196. Decree 196 removed the former six-month minimum remaining-validity condition, requiring the qualifying visa to be valid at entry.

unlocks.conditions: For specified nationalities applying for a Georgian e-Visa, a valid Schengen visa is accepted as a required supporting document
unlocks.notes: This is a simplified e-Visa eligibility privilege rather than universal visa-free entry. It applies only to nationalities listed by Georgia's e-Visa portal.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa and a valid passport. Entry without a Dominican consular visa applies strictly to tourist visits using a Tourist Card (Tarjeta de Turista); single-entry Schengen visas and work, study, or residence purposes are not covered.

source.verificationPath: MIREX > Portal Unico de Servicios > Servicios > Visas > Decreto Num. 691-07
source.exactQuote: El Decreto Núm. 691-07, del 18 de diciembre de 2007, facilita la entrada a la República Dominicana a extranjeros con residencia permanente o visado de entradas múltiples vigente en Estados Unidos, Unión Europea (Schengen), Canadá o Gran Bretaña. Pueden ingresar solo con pasaporte válido y una Tarjeta de Turismo para fines turísticos.

unlocks.notes: This entry records the valid multiple-entry Schengen visa exemption under Decreto Núm. 691-07. Entry under this exemption is for tourist purposes with a valid passport and Tourist Card for up to 30 days and does not authorize work, study, or residence.

unlocks.conditions: Indian nationals holding a valid and current Schengen visa qualify for visa-free tourism visits of up to 30 days.
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Passport valid at least six months beyond the intended stay; return or onward ticket; no derogatory Bureau of Immigration record.

source.verificationPath: PH Visa Policy > Non-Immigrant Visas > Free to enter the Philippines without Visa > Visa Policy for Indian Nationals
source.pageSection: Visa Policy for Indian Nationals: AJACSSUK visas and residence permits

unlocks.notes: Tourism only. The stay cannot be extended or converted to another admission category. This entry covers Indian nationals only.

unlocks.conditions: Nationals of DZ, AZ, BT, CR, CU, EG, SV, GT, HN, IN, JO, KG, LA, MV, MR, MX, MA, NI, PA, PE, TJ, TN, TM, VN holding a valid Schengen entry visa qualify for the 14-day visa exemption.
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Passport valid at least six months; return ticket; confirmed hotel reservation; health insurance; sufficient funds.

source.verificationPath: Visitors > Entry visas > Second group > Full text of the regulations

unlocks.notes: The 14-day stay cannot be extended or converted to a residence visa. Other nationalities and family-member exceptions are outside this entry.

unlocks.conditions: Indian nationals transiting to or from a third country may use the 96-hour VFTF with a Schengen visa valid for entry into Germany or Switzerland and valid for at least one month from Singapore entry.
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Confirmed onward air, ferry or cruise ticket departing within 96 hours. Entry may be by any transport mode; departure must be by air or sea.

source.verificationPath: Consular services > Visa information > Visa Free Transit Facility (VFTF) > Travellers who are nationals of India
source.pageSection: Indian nationals: valid visa/long-term pass, country list and Germany/Switzerland footnote

unlocks.notes: Transit only; not an unrestricted tourist exemption. ICA decides admission and no extension is allowed. The separate used single-journey-visa return exception is not covered.
